text: Following the postmortem: I don't think we should keep running our own Kafka. Nobody left on the team has real Kafka ops experience and it showed on the 14th.
Options are MSK (managed Kafka) or moving to Kinesis.
Kinesis means rewriting all 14 consumers. MSK keeps the Kafka protocol, consumers don't change.
Agreed, MSK. I'll open PLAT-212 to evaluate cost and write ADR-0011.
